ceu: ✦ The trine between Venus and Jupiter

s.k: Let joy in without asking permission.
t: With the Moon in your house of joy, creativity flows. Give shape to an idea you have been keeping to yourself.
Until {H:1828942863000}, the Moon is still in {S:3} and stirs up home and family.

The trine between Venus and Jupiter brings together, in your favour, your career and routine: Venus brings affection and harmony, Jupiter brings confidence and opportunities. An idea from today could become a real project.
s.d: Laugh at yourself when something goes less well.

t: Family and home take priority. A simple gesture of care has a very big effect today.
Until {H:1828942863000}, the Moon is still in {S:3} and stirs up conversations, contacts and short trips.

The trine between Venus and Jupiter brings together, in your favour, your horizons and romance: Venus brings affection and harmony, Jupiter brings confidence and opportunities. Trust what you are building: today the sky lends a hand.
s.d: Make peace with a childhood memory.

s.k: Curiosity switched on: ask, listen, learn.
t: Ideas come pouring in. Write them down: not all of them are for today, but some will be worth gold later on.
Until {H:1828942863000}, the Moon is still in {S:3} and stirs up your money and what you value.

The trine between Venus and Jupiter brings together, in your favour, intimacy and family: Venus brings affection and harmony, Jupiter brings confidence and opportunities. Smile more: kindness opens paths today.
s.d: Apologise for a careless word, if need be.

s.k: A day to sort out what really matters to you.
t: The Moon passes through your area of money and security. It is a good day to look at your accounts calmly and without fear.
Until {H:1828942863000}, the Moon is still in {S:3} and stirs up your image and your personal energy.

The trine between Venus and Jupiter brings together, in your favour, relationships and conversations: Venus brings affection and harmony, Jupiter brings confidence and opportunities. A small gesture can have a big effect today.
s.d: Put aside a small amount, just to build the habit.

s.k: Your presence speaks for itself today.
t: With the Moon in your sign, your intuition is sharper than usual. Trust what you feel at first impression.
Until {H:1828942863000}, the Moon is still in {S:3} and stirs up rest and your inner life.

The trine between Venus and Jupiter brings together, in your favour, routine and money: Venus brings affection and harmony, Jupiter brings confidence and opportunities. Be thankful for what goes well and say it out loud.
s.d: Look after your image: a haircut, a new piece of clothing or simply standing up straight.

t: With the Moon in your house of silence, dreams and intuition bring answers. Watch for the signs.
Until {H:1828942863000}, the Moon is still in {S:3} and stirs up friends and plans for the future.

The trine between Venus and Jupiter brings together, in your favour, romance and your image: Venus brings affection and harmony, Jupiter brings confidence and opportunities. Let things flow without forcing them.
s.d: Forgive yourself for something that is already in the past.

s.k: The right friends make all the difference.
t: The Moon favours sharing and helping one another. What you give to others comes back to you in other ways.
Until {H:1828942863000}, the Moon is still in {S:3} and stirs up your career and your goals.

The trine between Venus and Jupiter brings together, in your favour, family and your inner life: Venus brings affection and harmony, Jupiter brings confidence and opportunities. Put your heart and your head on the same side.
s.d: Picture your ideal future for five minutes, in detail.

s.k: A day to show what you are worth.
t: Others notice your effort. Do your best, even in the tasks nobody applauds.
Until {H:1828942863000}, the Moon is still in {S:3} and stirs up study, travel and broad horizons.

The trine between Venus and Jupiter brings together, in your favour, conversations and friendships: Venus brings affection and harmony, Jupiter brings confidence and opportunities. It is a day for sowing: what you do today grows over time.
s.d: Finish one important task before starting another.

s.k: Faith in the path opens the path.
t: The Moon passes through your area of horizons. You feel like learning, travelling or simply seeing things differently.
Until {H:1828942863000}, the Moon is still in {S:3} and stirs up intimacy and what you share with others.

The trine between Venus and Jupiter brings together, in your favour, money and your career: Venus brings affection and harmony, Jupiter brings confidence and opportunities. Use it to take a step you keep putting off.
s.d: Say a prayer or set an intention for your path.

s.k: What runs deep asks for truth.
t: Today is a day to let go of what weighs you down: a resentment, a habit, an old distrust.
Until {H:1828942863000}, the Moon is still in {S:3} and stirs up relationships and partnerships.

The trine between Venus and Jupiter brings together, in your favour, your image and your horizons: Venus brings affection and harmony, Jupiter brings confidence and opportunities. Accept whatever help comes along, wherever it comes from.
s.d: Take a deep breath whenever you feel jealousy or distrust.

s.k: Together you go further than alone.
t: With the Moon in your house of partnerships, the balance between giving and receiving is at stake. Look for the middle ground.
Until {H:1828942863000}, the Moon is still in {S:3} and stirs up routine, daily work and health.

The trine between Venus and Jupiter brings together, in your favour, your inner life and intimacy: Venus brings affection and harmony, Jupiter brings confidence and opportunities. It is a good moment to bring the two together in a single plan.
s.d: Ask the person beside you how you can help.

s.k: Your body is asking for attention: listen to it.
t: The Moon asks for method and care with the details. A small adjustment to your routine makes a difference.
Until {H:1828942863000}, the Moon is still in {S:3} and stirs up pleasure, creativity and romance.

The trine between Venus and Jupiter brings together, in your favour, friendships and relationships: Venus brings affection and harmony, Jupiter brings confidence and opportunities. Use this good energy to sort out what had stalled.
s.d: Get up from your chair every hour and stretch.
